title: Grusch: the symbol rate is too slow

tellings.quote: actually talking to David Gush about this in my interview with him and he was like it's almost like the symbol rate is too slow.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in an interview with David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer turned whistleblower, Grusch remarked that it is almost as if the symbol rate is too slow. Symbol rate means how fast information is passed along, and the remark, as Michels frames it, suggests our way of communicating may be too slow to connect with whatever intelligence lies behind these encounters.
